def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The real objects are dense, axis-aligned monochrome rectangles. Recover

    for r in range(h):

            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color
                            and (yy, xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            if len(cells) < 4:
                continue
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            area = (r1 - r0 + 1) * (c1 - c0 + 1)
            if area >= 4 and len(cells) / area >= 0.60:
                for y in range(r0, r1 + 1):
